name: Swiss Design
description: White, black, one red, and a grid with nothing extra.
bestFor: Posters and product UI that should feel objective and strictly aligned.
promptFragment: Visual style: Swiss Design. Use a white ground, black Helvetica-like sans, a single red action color, square corners, and no shadow. Align everything to a hard grid and let type do the work. Avoid decoration, texture, extra hues, and rounded pills. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
